title: Christmas Ornament Demon
description: A massive cracked Christmas bauble with a demonic bird head, glowing purple eyes, and holly wreath hangs inside a ruined gothic cathedral. Below, a female sorceress with white hair holds a glowing blue staff while a horned devil in a red cape and a kneeling red-robed figure perform a ritual on a blood-stained magic circle.
prompt: Inside a crumbling gothic cathedral with broken stained glass windows revealing a starry night sky and distant castle, a giant cracked Christmas bauble ornament hangs from the ceiling. The ornament has a demonic bird head with glowing purple eyes, sharp beak, and holly wreath. Red blood drips from its base. In the foreground, a long-haired sorceress in a dark purple robe holds a glowing blue star staff, standing beside a horned devil in a flowing red and black cape and a kneeling figure in red robes, all performing a blood ritual on a circular magic circle on the stone floor.
